scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/backend && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run generate && npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @fit-track/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @fit-track/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run generate && npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspace @fit-track/shared && npm run lint --workspace @fit-track/backend && npm run lint --workspace @fit-track/frontend
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:docker: docker compose -f compose.test.yaml up --build --remove-orphans --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from tests tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fit-track/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fit-track/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @fit-track/frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:shared: npm run lint --workspace @fit-track/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fit-track/shared && prettier --check shared && npm run test --workspace @fit-track/shared && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/shared
scripts.verify:backend: npm run generate && npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspace @fit-track/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @fit-track/backend && prettier --check backend && npm run test --workspace @fit-track/backend && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/backend
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspace @fit-track/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace @fit-track/frontend && prettier --check frontend && npm run test --workspace @fit-track/frontend && npm run build --workspace @fit-track/frontend
scripts.verify:integration: npm run verify && npm run test:integration
